request: Build a tapping game in this empty project. A counter named `time_left` starts at 10 and drops by 1 every second of game time (60 fixed ticks, so it is 9 from tick 60). While it is above 0, every tap of an input action named `tap` (the space bar) adds 1 to a counter named `score`, which starts at 0. When `time_left` reaches 0 it stays at 0, the screen says `Time up!`, and taps no longer score. Show the score and the time left on screen.
